title: [MCP] Add codeunit APIs as MCP tools in MCP configuration
summary: Codeunit APIs are now integrated into MCP configuration as a new object type alongside API pages and queries, with unified selection UI and metadata sourced from the Api Web Service table.
key_points: Codeunits are added as an MCP tool object type, at parity with API pages and queries, with a new CreateCodeunitAPITool facade
API metadata for pages, queries and codeunits now comes from the Api Web Service table, and only published APIs are listed
The API Overview page lists pages, queries and codeunits, and its Entity column shows the entity set name
Allow Bound Actions is renamed to Allow Actions; AllowBoundActions is deprecated, and for codeunit tools Allow Actions is the invoke toggle
Microsoft and standard beta pages are excluded from selection, while third-party beta pages stay available
quote: Adds Codeunit as a new object type in the MCP configuration UI, at parity with API pages and queries
